units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 119:78">Targ. Ps. CXIX, 78</cite>. Targ. II Esth. I, 1 <he>מלכא מְעַוְּותָא</he> a tyrannous king.
<cite ref="Berakhot 14b:23">Ber. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>שלוחא הוא דע׳</he> the servant did the wrong thing.

<cite ref="Ketubot 85a">Keth. 85ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>לתקוני שדרתיך ולא לעַוּוּתֵי</he> I deputed thee to do the right thing (to benefit me), but not to do it wrong (impair my cause); <cite ref="Nedarim 36a">Ned. 36ᵃ</cite>
